title: Research section: tag and listing page for research-oriented articles
description: Add a research tag and a listing page modelled on the platform page. Move the Jev and Laya bias series, Benford and decision-model pieces, turn detection, and the few-shot draft under it. Purpose: keep the home page for buyer content and give solutions pages somewhere to link for credibility. Research-shaped drafts (Ralph loops, code-based hill-climbing, wiki that only gets bigger) can ship into this section as they are ready.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Built /research (src/pages/research.js) + src/components/research-cards.jsx modeled on platform.js/platform-cards.jsx, reusing platform.module.css grid/card styles. Added 'research' tag to 16 site-content articles' frontmatter (both block-list and flow-list YAML forms): one-word-test, encoding-prejudice, can-you-fix-it, jev-vs-laya, can-you-trust-jev-confidence, fine-tuning-jev, distilling-jev-into-a-classifier, jev-useful-decisions, decision-models-are-not-calculators, the-dominance-of-ones, few-shot-learning-isnt-real, domain-specific-turn-detection, code-based-hill-climbing, ralph-loops, wiki-that-only-gets-bigger, teaching-via-data (12 published, 4 draft, so the listing shows 12). Added 'Research' to gatsby-config.mjs menuLinks next to 'Platform' (nav only -- footer 'Platform' link comes from the external anthus-footer npm package via getPlatformLinks() and isn't editable here). Did not touch home page or blog index per instructions. Build verification (npm run build) was in progress at handoff -- schema/query extraction and HTML-renderer stages succeeded with no errors from my changes (only pre-existing warnings unrelated to this task, e.g. a childImageSharp/svg warning on an unrelated file). Image processing for the full image-heavy site takes several minutes; final public/research/index.html existence was not confirmed before this comment. Left in_progress per instructions for the parent session to close after commit.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Build verification completed after my earlier comment: npm run build finished successfully (Done building in 351.9s, exit code 0). Confirmed public/research/index.html exists with

Research

and links to all 11 published research-tagged articles (can-you-fix-it, can-you-trust-jev-confidence, decision-models-are-not-calculators, distilling-jev-into-a-classifier, domain-specific-turn-detection, encoding-prejudice, fine-tuning-jev, jev-vs-laya, making-decisions-instead-of-generating-text [jev-useful-decisions.mdx's actual slug], one-word-test, the-dominance-of-ones). The 'ERROR UNKNOWN' lines seen mid-build were just node punycode deprecation-warning noise from worker processes and pre-existing 'Citation must be used within a CitationsProvider' console.error logs from MDX rendering elsewhere in the site (not thrown, don't fail the build, unrelated to my changes). Confirmed the Research nav link renders on the home page too. This closes out the verification step; task can be closed after commit.
